xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4492: Composer messages to Claude Code on Herdr sometimes arrive without Enter: Herdr delivery has no submit verification

plan.title: Composer messages to Claude Code on Herdr sometimes arrive without Enter: Herdr delivery has no submit verification
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: On a Herdr host a composer message to a Claude Code conversation is delivered by Herdr's agent.prompt, which types the text and presses Enter in one breath. A large paste can still be ingesting when the Enter arrives, so the Enter is lost and the message sits in Claude Code's input box while the dashboard reports it delivered. The tmux path guards against this (paste-visible wait, size-scaled settle, post-Enter check with one resend); the Herdr path has none of these.
narratives.Proposal: For Herdr-detected Claude Code agents (agent === 'claude', no wait option) and every steer, HerdrBackend.prompt stops calling agent.prompt and calls a new pasteAndSubmitHerdrPane (src/lib/terminal-backends/herdr-submit.ts): pane.send_text in bracketed paste, wait until the composer shows the payload (or a [Pasted text #N placeholder) and a 600 ms-3 s settle has passed, press Enter (or the steer chord) with pane.send_keys, watch the composer for 2 s, and press it exactly once more only when the payload is still there, the agent is not blocked and no menu/permission prompt is on screen. The composer is located on a cursor-less screen read by a new screenComposerPayloadPresence in pane-composer.ts (rows between the last two rule rows). A committed soak script reproduces the bug before the wiring lands and proves 20/20 after.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the tmux path, PTY supervisor, app-server, ACP, Channels, or Kimi delivery
- No change for non-Claude Herdr-detected harnesses; they keep agent.prompt
- Prompts that pass options.wait keep agent.prompt
- No transcript-based submit confirmation inside delivery; watchForEatenConversationMessage is unchanged
- No re-paste when the paste never shows in the composer
- No new fields on PromptResult or DeliveryResult; src/lib/agents/delivery.ts is not modified
- Never more than one resubmit per delivery
- Never press Enter or the steer chord while a menu, permission prompt, or blocked status is present
- No raising of any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row

autoDecisions.summary: Replace agent.prompt with Overdeck's own paste -> verify -> submit -> verify for Claude Code panes, instead of only adding a check after agent.prompt
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue permits either. Only the in-place form restores the pre-Enter paste wait and settle that address the root cause; the steer path already proves pane.send_text + pane.send_keys in production; no production caller passes wait and delivery.ts ignores the returned state.

autoDecisions.summary: Scope the new routine to Herdr agents whose agent field is 'claude' (and all steers); other harnesses and waited prompts keep agent.prompt
autoDecisions.rationale: The composer parser targets Claude Code's layout and every acceptance criterion is about Claude Code; leaving other harnesses untouched keeps blast radius small.

autoDecisions.summary: Steer joins the same routine and resubmits with ctrl+x ctrl+s; steerHerdrPane is deleted
autoDecisions.rationale: Steer had the same missing guarantees and is Claude-only; the tmux steer chaser already resends with the chord, so this matches it.

autoDecisions.summary: Pane presence is the only submit signal; no transcript check in the routine
autoDecisions.rationale: A queued message on a busy agent does not reach the transcript until the turn ends, and pan tell to work agents has no transcript offset; a busy Claude Code still clears its composer on Enter.

autoDecisions.summary: Resubmit only on positive evidence (payload present, not blocked, no menu); unproven never resubmits; max one resubmit
autoDecisions.rationale: An extra Enter while a menu shows answers it (PAN-3212, PAN-4278); an Enter on an empty composer is a no-op, so positive-evidence-only is safe.

autoDecisions.summary: Locate the composer without a cursor row by the last two rule rows (one-rule fallback: rows above it)
autoDecisions.rationale: Herdr pane.read has no cursor; the live capture shows the composer between two ─── rows; the one-rule fallback's worst case is one harmless Enter on an empty composer.

autoDecisions.summary: Log resubmits with a [herdr-submit] console.warn line instead of new result fields
autoDecisions.rationale: delivery.ts has one line of file-size headroom and the AC only requires the log to record the resubmit.

autoDecisions.summary: New module imports only pane-composer, pane-choice-menu and steer-keys, and takes the Herdr API structurally
autoDecisions.rationale: agent-pane-io.ts is in baselined import cycle 32 and reaches herdr.ts through launch.ts; importing it (or permission-prompt.ts, which imports it) would create a new cycle and fail lint:circular. paneHasBlockingChoiceMenu already reports permission menus.

autoDecisions.summary: Commit scripts/herdr-submit-soak.ts for the reproduction and the 20-send acceptance run, with an explicit fallback when no Herdr host is reachable
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks to reproduce first and AC-1 needs 20 consecutive sends; a script makes both repeatable for the work and test roles.

Create herdr-submit.ts: paste, verify paste, submit, verify submit, resubmit once

expected_outputs: herdr-submit.test.ts passes all eight PRD W2 cases

narrative.Action: PRD W2. New module src/lib/terminal-backends/herdr-submit.ts exporting HerdrSubmitApi (structural {call}), HerdrSubmitDeps {sleep, now}, HerdrSubmitOutcome ('submitted'|'resubmitted'|'held'|'unconfirmed'|'blocked'), PASTE_VISIBLE_TIMEOUT_MS=3000, SUBMIT_CONFIRM_MS=2000, POLL_INTERVAL_MS=50, pasteSettleMs(text) (tmux formula: max(600, min(3000, lines*15 + floor(len/1000)*50))), and pasteAndSubmitHerdrPane(api, paneId, text, mode='enter', deps). Imports ONLY ../pane-composer.js, ../pane-choice-menu.js, ./steer-keys.js (never agent-pane-io or permission-prompt: import cycle). Algorithm per PRD W2 steps 1-6: pane.send_text bracketed; poll pane.read (source 'visible', lines 200, strip_ansi true) until 'present' or 3 s, then sleep out pasteSettleMs from start; never-visible + (agent.get blocked or paneHasBlockingChoiceMenu) -> log and return 'blocked' with no keys; press submit keys (['enter'] or [...STEER_HERDR_KEYS]); poll up to 2 s, first 'absent' -> 'submitted'; at deadline 'unproven' -> 'unconfirmed'; 'present' + blocked/menu -> log '[herdr-submit] ... not resending ... (PAN-4492)' and 'held'; else console.warn '[herdr-submit] <pane>: message still in Claude Code's input box 2000 ms after <label>; resubmitting once (PAN-4492)', press submit keys once more, 'resubmitted'. A pane.read throw counts as unproven (never rejects); a pane.send_text throw propagates. Write a 6-10 line module header (why agent.prompt's Enter races paste ingestion, never answer a menu, one-resubmit cap). Tests use injected sleep/now or vi.useFakeTimers (no real waits).

items.title: Given the payload clears from the composer after the first Enter, when pasteAndSubmitHerdrPane runs, then exactly one pane.send_keys ['enter'] is recorded and the outcome is 'submitted'

Given the payload stays in the composer for the whole 2000 ms window with agent.get 'idle' and no menu, then two pane.send_keys ['enter'] calls are recorded, the outcome is 'resubmitted', and console.warn emits a line containing 'resubmitting once (PAN-4492)'

Given the payload stays and agent.get answers 'blocked' or the screen's bottom rows are the permission-menu fixture, then exactly one pane.send_keys is recorded and the outcome is 'held'; given the paste is never visible and agent.get answers 'blocked', then zero pane.send_keys are recorded and the outcome is 'blocked'

Given mode 'steer' and a payload that stays, then both pane.send_keys calls carry ['ctrl+x','ctrl+s'] and none carries 'enter'; given every pane.read returns '' or throws, then one pane.send_keys is recorded, the promise resolves, and the outcome is 'unconfirmed'

expected_outputs: --help prints the usage line naming --conv, --cwd, --session, --count, --bytes and --tail

narrative.Action: PRD W4. Developer script run with `npx tsx scripts/herdr-submit-soak.ts --conv <name> --cwd <dir> --session <claudeSessionId> [--count 20] [--bytes 5120] [--tail "<last line>"]` (plus --help); --tail replaces the default last line 'Reply with exactly: ok'. Run it as a .ts file (planning verified delivery.ts, herdr.ts and transcript-landing.ts load under npx tsx from a file; `npx tsx -e` fails only on top-level await). Per send: message = first line `soak-<i>-<uuid>`, ~bytes of 64-char filler lines, last line `Reply with exactly: ok`; start offset from captureTranscriptUserRecordSnapshot(cwd, session) (readOffset ?? fileSize ?? 0); deliver via deliverAgentMessage(conv, message, 'herdr-submit-soak', undefined, { sender: { id: `conv-operator-${process.pid}` } }); poll probeTranscriptSince(cwd, session, offset, message) every 1 s up to 60 s; then Effect.runPromise(herdrBackend.wait({ agentName: conv }, ['idle','done'], 180_000)). Print `#i landed|NOT LANDED in <ms>` per send and `landed X/N`; exit 0 only when all landed. Implementation checkpoint: BEFORE w3 lands, run it with --count 10 against a scratch Claude Code conversation (create from the dashboard on the cheapest Claude model; get cwd and claudeSessionId from `curl -s localhost:3011/api/conversations/<name>`) and write the baseline `landed X/10` into the PR description. Fallback: if no Herdr host or dashboard is reachable, write 'baseline not measured: <reason>' in the PR description and continue.

Live-verify 20 consecutive 5 KB sends and the menu hold on a Herdr host

narrative.Action: PRD W5. With w3 applied in the workspace: (1) run `npx tsx scripts/herdr-submit-soak.ts --conv <scratch> --cwd <cwd> --session <id> --count 20 --bytes 5120` against a scratch Claude Code conversation on Herdr and paste the summary plus any '[herdr-submit]' lines into the PR description. (2) A permission prompt cannot be staged (bypass permissions + auto-approve hook), so open Claude Code's /effort picker instead: `herdr --session overdeck pane send-text <pane> '/effort'` then `herdr --session overdeck pane send-keys <pane> enter`; confirm `herdr --session overdeck agent get <conv>` shows agent_status blocked; run the script with --count 1; expect '#1 NOT LANDED', no '[herdr-submit]' line, and the picker still on screen via `herdr --session overdeck pane read <pane> --source visible`; dismiss with `pane send-keys <pane> esc`. (3) Make the agent busy with `--count 1 --tail "Count slowly from 1 to 200, one number per line."`, and while agent get shows working run `--count 1` again; expect no 'resubmitting once (PAN-4492)' line and the second message lands after the turn. If a resubmit line appears, record the screen in the PR description and treat it as a blocking W2 finding. (4) Close the scratch conversation. Fallback: if no Herdr host is reachable from the agent environment, write 'live verification deferred to the test role' in the PR description. No source changes are expected here; a script fix, if needed, is made here.

items.title: Given an idle Claude Code conversation on a Herdr host, when the soak script runs with --count 20 --bytes 5120 against the branch code, then it prints 'landed 20/20' and exits 0

Given the scratch agent is blocked on the /effort picker (agent get reports blocked), when the soak script sends one message, then it prints '#1 NOT LANDED', logs no '[herdr-submit]' line, and `herdr pane read --source visible` still renders the picker

Given the scratch agent is working on a long turn, when the soak script sends one more message, then no line containing 'resubmitting once (PAN-4492)' is logged and the message lands as a user record after the turn ends
Given the PR description, when a reviewer reads it, then it contains the 'landed 20/20' summary or the text 'live verification deferred to the test role'
